summary: Russia launched a massive overnight missile and drone barrage on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, damaging the Northern Bridge, residential buildings, and energy infrastructure, resulting in multiple casualties and widespread power outages. In response, Ukrainian forces continued strikes on Russian oil refineries, hitting the Saratov facility as part of a sustained campaign against energy assets. Meanwhile, diplomatic efforts continue with Ukrainian and Russian delegations preparing for talks in Abu Dhabi, though NATO warns that compromises will be necessary for any peace agreement.
key_points: Russia launched a massive combined missile and drone attack on Kyiv, damaging the Northern Bridge, residential buildings, and energy infrastructure, causing casualties and power outages (Source: UkraineNow/85155, mon1tor_ua/78031).

Ukrainian intelligence identified Colonel Fedir Zubakov and four Su-34 aircraft as responsible for the deadly strike on the gymnasium in Komishuvakha, which killed 55 people with up to 30 more feared under rubble (Source: UkraineNow/85164).
Ukrainian forces struck the Saratov Oil Refinery (capacity ~7 million tons/year) and hit two Iskander launchers and a Pantsir-S1 system in Bryansk (Source: eRadarrua/129217, UkraineNow/85155).
Ukrainian and Russian delegations are preparing for upcoming peace talks in Abu Dhabi, with Kyiv emphasizing self-determination in peace terms (Source: UkraineNow/85152, UkraineNow/85158).
NATO Secretary General Rutte stated that peace is possible but requires compromises, noting that Ukraine is unlikely to recover all its territory (Source: UkraineNow/85149).
Trump appointed Stephen Miller, a critic of Ukraine who advocated for US reimbursement of aid, as White House Chief of Staff (Source: UkraineNow/85170).

Russian forces launched a sustained campaign of Shahed drones and Geran-5 missiles targeting energy infrastructure across Chernihiv, Kyiv, and Mykolaiv regions (Source: mon1tor_ua/78036, mon1tor_ua/78033).

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive overnight missile and drone barrage on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, damaging the Northern Bridge, residential buildings, and energy infrastructure, resulting in multiple casualties and widespread power outages. In response, Ukrainian forces continued strikes on Russian oil refineries, hitting the Saratov facility as part of a campaign targeting energy infrastructure. Meanwhile, diplomatic efforts continue with Ukrainian and Russian delegations preparing for talks in Abu Dhabi, though NATO warns that compromises will be necessary for any peace agreement.

points: Russian missile and drone strikes targeted Kyiv, damaging the Northern Bridge, a residential building, and a kindergarten in the Solomianskyi district, with 5 reported casualties. Ukrainian air defenses faced a massive ballistic missile attack, with reports of up to 8 Tsirkons and multiple reactive Shahed drones targeting Kyiv, Vyshhorod, and surrounding areas.

The energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr was struck, causing power outages in Kyiv and reduced water pressure, with repair crews working to assess and restore services. President Zelensky warned of further Russian attacks on energy infrastructure, bridges across the Dnipro, and civilian facilities, emphasizing the critical need for air defense and repair capabilities.

Ukrainian intelligence identified Colonel Fedir Zubakov as the planner of the strike on the gymnasium in Komishuvakha, which killed 55 people with up to 30 more feared under rubble. Ukrainian General Staff reported successful strikes on Russian Iskander launchers and a Pantsir-S1 air defense system in Bryansk region.

Chernihiv region suffered a complete power outage affecting approximately 150,000 subscribers across multiple districts and the city of Chernihiv. Ukrainian forces successfully targeted Russian oil refining infrastructure, including the Saratov refinery, as part of a sustained campaign to degrade Russian energy assets.

Ukrainian forces launched a strike on the Saratov Oil Refinery, which has a capacity of approximately 7 million tons of crude oil per year, marking the seventh refinery targeted since late October. Ukrainian drone and missile strikes reportedly hit two Iskander missile launchers and a Pantsir-S1 air defense system in Bryansk region.

Russian forces launched Shahed and Geran-5 drones, as well as Tsirkon and Iskander missiles, from regions including Bryansk, Kursk, and the Black Sea towards Ukrainian targets. Russian cruise missiles and loitering munitions, including 'Banderoz' and 'Flamingo' types, were launched towards targets in Poltava, Orel, and other regions.

Russian forces reportedly advanced near Svitlyi and Vasylivka, according to updated battlefield maps from DeepStateUA. Ukrainian forces targeted Russian positions in the Bryansk region, successfully hitting Iskander launchers and air defense systems.

Russian tactical aviation dropped guided bombs on Dnipropetrovsk and Zaporizhzhia regions. Reactive UAVs were launched from Kharkiv region towards Poltava region and from Dnipropetrovsk region towards Poltava region.

Russian forces launched a massive missile attack on Kyiv and the surrounding region, targeting critical infrastructure including the Northern Bridge and energy facilities. Multiple ballistic missiles and reactive UAVs were detected flying towards Kyiv, Vyshhorod, Brovary, and Makariv from Chernihiv, Sumy, and Bryansk regions.

Chernihiv region suffered a complete power outage affecting approximately 150,000 subscribers across multiple districts and the city of Chernihiv. Ukrainian air defense and aviation actively engaged incoming threats, with reports of successful intercepts and the downing of multiple missiles and drones.

Russian forces launched reactive UAVs from the Black Sea towards the Mykolaiv region, targeting areas like Veselynovyi and Voznesensk. Ukrainian defense forces intercepted and engaged multiple groups of reactive UAVs and cruise missiles heading towards southern and central regions.

A strike was recorded on the Saratov Oil Refinery, impacting Russian fuel supply chains. Ukrainian naval and air defense forces maintained vigilance over the Black Sea corridor to counter drone and missile launches.

Russian tactical aviation deployed Su-34 fighter-bombers to strike the gymnasium in Komishuvakha, resulting in a high-casualty event. Massive ballistic missile attacks featuring Tsirkon hypersonic missiles and Iskander-M systems targeted Kyiv and surrounding areas.

Ukrainian air defense systems were heavily engaged, reporting successful intercepts of multiple cruise missiles and loitering munitions. Russian forces utilized a mix of Geran-5 missiles, Shahed drones, and Banderoz loitering munitions in coordinated strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions.
